rule: Standards applicability is registry-driven. The current primary Malaysian/JAKIM standards catalogue and every verified applicable product/technical instrument remain first-class applicability candidates. Exact normative text is used only from verified/licensed sources; certification authority remains with the competent authority.
scope_rule: The platform evaluates the complete applicable Malaysian/JAKIM Halal framework. MS 1500 and MS 2400 are not the entire standards universe, and the architecture is not hard-coded to a fixed standards count.
